answers.q1: pnpm (pinned as pnpm@12.9.1 in package.json; `preinstall` runs `npx only-allow pnpm`, so npm and yarn are rejected). Node must be ^20.19.0 || >=22.12.0. Install with: `pnpm install`. CI also runs `pnpm playwright install chromium` for the e2e tests and `pnpm run build` before testing.
answers.q2: `pnpm test`. This runs `pnpm test-unit && pnpm test-serve && pnpm test-build`, which is `vitest run`, then `vitest run -c vitest.config.e2e.ts`, then the same with VITE_TEST_BUILD=1. CI does `pnpm run build` first and also runs `pnpm run test-serve-bundled`. Run `pnpm playwright install chromium` beforehand for the e2e tests. For unit tests only, use `pnpm test-unit`.
answers.q3: `pnpm exec vitest run packages/vite/src/node/__tests__/config.spec.ts`. Append `-t "<test name>"` to narrow to one test. The root vitest.config.ts includes `**/__tests__/**/*.spec.[tj]s`, so no `-c` flag is needed. Build first with `pnpm build` if the test needs built output.
answers.q4: CI's lint job runs these in order: `pnpm run build`, `pnpm run lint`, `pnpm format && git diff --exit-code`, `pnpm run typecheck`, `pnpm run test-docs`. `pnpm run lint` is `eslint --cache . --concurrency auto`. `pnpm format` is `oxfmt`, and the `git diff --exit-code` after it fails if formatting changed anything. To check formatting without modifying files, `pnpm exec oxfmt --check` should work, but I didn't confirm that flag. Lint and format are the core of the CI check. Typecheck and test-docs are extra CI steps.
answers.q5: Generated, don't edit by hand: `pnpm-lock.yaml`; `dist/` build output (including packages/*/dist); `packages/vite/LICENSE` (gitignored, generated at build time); `playground-temp/` and `temp/` (test scratch copies); `.eslintcache`; `docs/.vitepress/cache` and `docs/.vitepress/.temp`; `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` (excluded from formatting and generated at release time, an inference from the ignore entry). Vendored or fixture content, which the lint and format configs exclude: `packages/create-vite/template-*` (scaffold templates, ignored by eslint) and `**/fixtures/**` (eslint-ignored test fixtures). Also vendored: `playground/external/public/slash@3.0.0.js` and `playground/ssr-html/public/slash@3.0.0.js`, which are third-party library files kept as-is. The `AGENTS.md` block between the `agentbrief:start` and `agentbrief:end` markers is generated by `agentbrief sync`; edit only outside it.
